title: Input OTP
description: One-time code entry (OTP, PIN, 2FA): boxes on screen, one real input underneath, so paste, SMS autofill, screen readers and the number keypad work like a normal field.
when: Verification codes, PINs, invite codes of a fixed length.
a11y: A single labelled input with autocomplete="one-time-code" and inputmode="numeric"; the boxes are decoration; invalid sets aria-invalid.
